chronology.initial_transcription_origin: The repository history does not establish which source supplied the initial PR #32 21-by-3 transcription.
chronology.production_transcription: The depth-2b production transcription was independently re-established against the official Nature Table 1 page pinned by hust_2018_aaf_depth_2b_official_source_v1.

article.locator: Table 1, Nature 560, p. 584; dedicated Nature Table 1 page
article.claim: Table 1 reports contributions to the main one-standard-deviation error budget in parts per million for the individual AAF determinations.

supplement.claim: Section 6 describes statistical angular-acceleration errors as independent between AAF runs and treats the same non-statistical item as fully correlated across runs.

project_derivation.rounding_envelope_rule: For each displayed component x, independently evaluate max(0, x - 0.005) and x + 0.005; compare the resulting squared-budget bounds with the squared budget from x.
project_derivation.dominant_pair_rule: rho_bound = max(nominal_sum_of_squares - lower_sum_of_squares, upper_sum_of_squares - nominal_sum_of_squares) / (2 * u_largest * u_second_largest)

correlation_policy.qualification: Zero pairwise covariance represents the published individual-column RSS budget only; it is not a claim that all underlying physical systematic sources are independent.
correlation_policy.cross_run_scope: Cross-run covariance is irrelevant to the three separate individual reconstructions and remains reserved for a separately authorized combined estimator.

nonclaims: The individual RSS rule is a project derivation from the published rounded columns, not a verbatim publication statement.
The displayed totals and published final uncertainties remain terminal diagnostics and are not computational inputs.
This clarification does not rewrite or relabel any historical depth-2a or feasibility artifact.
